title: VIXEN preset commands need a working-directory guard
body: The documented VIXEN configure preset lives under VIXEN/, but invoking cmake --preset vixen-wsl from the repository root fails with a missing CMakePresets.json before configuration. A wrapper or preset entrypoint should resolve the source directory or emit a direct correction.

title: GPU editor witness needs a root-relative environment launcher
body: The queued windowed editor witness failed before launch when invoked from the repository root because vixen-gpu-env.sh and appflow_client were only addressed relative to VIXEN; the workaround is to run from VIXEN or resolve both paths from the repository root.

title: Recipe service codegen must include the declared SurfacePoint schema source
body: The queued --recipe-services generator failed at the c58 MaterialRef/SampleSurface input with 'element schema SurfacePoint must have one source declaration (found 0)' because CMake passed SDFInstruction and kernel callables but not RecipeElementKinds.cs. The workaround was to add that canonical declaration as a repeatable --recipe-kernels-extra input; keep recipe service generation declarative over all referenced schema declarations.

title: VIXEN wave merge must preserve the recipe-service provider target
body: After merging origin/wave/authoring-convergence, RecipeServices.h consumers remained but VIXEN/codegen/CMakeLists.txt no longer defined the documented --recipe-services custom command or linked recipe_cpu_service, recipe_gpu_service, and recipe_analysis_service. The merged editor then failed with missing YkRecipeAnalysis.h. Recovery restored the provider generation block and its dependencies; the merge contract should retain or regenerate this wiring automatically.
